end.summary:
Identified place values in 2,406: 2 thousands, 4 hundreds, 0 tens, 6 ones.
Explained that zero holds an empty place in a 4-digit number.
Needed support to keep all place-value positions when combining digits.
Read 8,614 as “aath hazaar chhah sau chaudah” and connected it to 8,000 + 600 + 14.
Teach-back was not passed; lesson ended when Diya asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value and reading 4-digit numbers with Diya. Diya correctly identified the thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones in 2,406 and explained why zero holds the tens place. They mixed up combining place values and reduced 2,406 to 42; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, practise building numbers with four cards labelled thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones, keeping a zero card in any empty place.
